pandas.to_numeric

pandas 3.1.1 · General functions · function

Parse input as numbers. Use errors="coerce" for invalid input and downcast when a smaller numeric dtype is suitable.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

pd.to_numeric(arg, errors='raise', downcast=None, dtype_backend=…)

Run the example

Edit the example and select Run Python to see the result.


    

    
Parameters
ParameterRequirementAccepted values and behavior
arg
      Required
Positional or keyword		
      scalar, list, tuple, 1-d array, Index, or Series
Pass a scalar or one-dimensional array-like of numeric values or strings.


errors
      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default 'raise'		
      {'raise', 'coerce'}
Choose "raise" for invalid values or "coerce" to turn them into missing values.


downcast
      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default None		
      str
Choose "integer", "signed", "unsigned", or "float" to use a smaller compatible numeric dtype.


dtype_backend
      Optional
Positional or keyword		
      {'numpy_nullable', 'pyarrow'}
Choose nullable NumPy-backed dtypes or Arrow-backed dtypes.

    
Returns
scalar, Series, Index, numpy.ndarray, or ExtensionArray
